_meta.description: Known Fantomons of Sword x Staff: type, rarity, skill, how obtained. type/rarity are null where no source states them; *_inferred holds our best guess (see systems/fantomons.md). tier is S/A/B from S-02 (S) and S-26 (A/B, tier D).

fantomons.name: Nyxarchon
fantomons.skill_effect: When a damaging Technique is used, deals Dark DMG once to one target and all enemies within 2 grids; 100% chance of 1 stack of 10% DEF Reduction (max 3) for 2 turns; at most twice every 2 turns.
fantomons.obtain: Summon Crystal exchange (60, tier D number)
fantomons.notes: Best DPS Main; aptitudes give Crit Rate and Accuracy; Immortal skill gives about 30% Crit Rate and Accuracy.

fantomons.name: Aegiswing
fantomons.skill_effect: At battle start grants Guardian Angel for 3 turns; when it expires, restores 50% of lost HP and grants Power Unsealed for the battle.
fantomons.adult_notes: Adult form adds Taunt/Retribution effects (tier D).
fantomons.obtain: Summon Crystal exchange (60, tier D number)
fantomons.notes: Best Tank Main; aptitudes give Block and Block Efficiency; PvP utility.

fantomons.name: Pandarial
fantomons.skill_effect: At battle start reduces every Technique's cooldown by 1 turn and gives a battle-long damage boost (tier D wording).
fantomons.adult_notes: Adult skills (tier D): Bamboo Gale / Verdant Spikes (damage, Fragility: +5% damage taken), Emerald Dew (heals allies within 4 grids).
fantomons.obtain: Summon Crystal exchange from day 46 of Season 2
fantomons.notes: Best Deployed Fantomon for every class; Healing Boost aptitude for supports; better than Aegiswing in 4v4.

fantomons.name: Sylvaerie
fantomons.skill_effect: Raises the caster's ATK and SPD for 1 turn after the caster's turn ends.
fantomons.obtain: Summon; rotating Legendary in the Summon Crystal shop (18, tier D)

fantomons.name: Zeioletus
fantomons.skill_effect: When a damaging Technique is used, deals Light DMG once to one target and all enemies within 1 grid and knocks them airborne; at most twice every 2 turns; +20% DMG to large targets.
fantomons.notes: Attack sub in SOF's lineup; named as an Adult filler.

fantomons.name: Armopi
fantomons.skill_effect: 1 stack of DEF Up at the end of the caster's turn; at 3 stacks removes them and grants a shield based on the caster's DEF.
fantomons.notes: Named by SOF as an Adult filler.

fantomons.name: Kels
fantomons.skill_effect: When a damaging Technique is used, deals Water DMG once to one target and dispels 1 random buff; once per turn.
fantomons.adult_notes: Adult 'Water Drill': 50% base chance of -20% DEF for 2 turns (tier D).
fantomons.obtain: Arena shop shards (60 shards, tier D); not in the summon pool (tier D)

fantomons.name: Terragon
fantomons.skill_effect: When a damaging Technique is used, deals Physical DMG once to one target, 50% base chance to reduce its ATK by 25% for 1 turn; once per turn.

fantomons.name: Herbote
fantomons.skill_effect: If the caster starts a turn below 80% HP, heals the caster once, with a 50% chance to dispel 1 ailment or debuff.

fantomons.name: Mandragora
fantomons.skill_effect: When a Technique is used on allies, heals 1 target once.

fantomons.name: Falko
fantomons.skill_effect: When a damaging Technique is used, deals Physical DMG once to one target and all enemies within 1 grid.

fantomons.name: Boaro
fantomons.skill_effect: Each time the caster cumulatively loses 15% of max HP, grants a shield based on the caster's DEF; up to 5 times per battle.

fantomons.name: Chomusuke
fantomons.skill_effect: Extra Physical area attack after a damaging Technique, 50% chance of -15% DEF (tier D).
fantomons.notes: Only in S-26; probably a KonoSuba collaboration Fantomon.
